title: How the AI ROI Gap Comes Down to Trust
summary: Companies investing in trustworthy AI practices are far more likely to see strong returns from the technology, according to new research from SAS. But trust remains a hurdle: 97% of users override AI recommendations at least some of the time, while employees are less likely to trust increasingly autonomous AI agents. Jay Upchurch, SAS Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer, joins Bloomberg's Anna Edwards on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dronemaker UForce In Talks For Around $5 Billion Value In Valor Equity-Led Raise
summary: UForce, a London-based drone startup, is in discussions to raise new financing at a valuation of about $5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Huawei’s $3,000 Device Is China’s Answer to Foldable iPhone
summary: Huawei Technologies Co. and Xiaomi Corp. are raising the stakes in China’s smartphone arena just days before Apple Inc.’s first foray into the foldable category.

title: ByteDance Founder Joins AI Elite in Race to Perfect World Models
summary: ByteDance Ltd. is readying an AI model geared for real-time spatial video generation, taking on Meta Platforms Inc. and Alphabet Inc. in an arena with applications in robotics and autonomous systems.

title: Preferred Networks CEO Eyes IPO Amid AI Chip Race
summary: Japanese startup Preferred Networks is seeking to go public to mass-produce its chips, reflecting the rising cost and scale needed to stay competitive in the global AI race, CEO Daisuke Okanohara said in an interview with Bloomberg News. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Go Taxi App Says Ridership Good Despite Fare Hikes
summary: Go Inc., the taxi booking app operator that pulled off Japan’s biggest initial public offering this year, said it is sustaining strong ride volume even after fare hikes.

title: When Will We Achieve AGI? AI Leaders Now Say It’s a Fuzzy Target
summary: Reaching the point when AI handles most tasks better than humans had been seen as a measurable achievement

title: CD Projekt Ramps Up Spending on Next ‘Witcher’ Game as Pipeline Expands
summary: CD Projekt Red SA is ramping up investment as it prepares the next chapter of its flagship monster-hunting Witcher franchise, with several projects now in development.

title: Deadly Amazon Cargo Plane Crash Overshoots Runway in Miami
summary: An Amazon cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport, killing at least five people and temporarily shutting down the airport’s runways during the busy Labor Day travel weekend. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Uber Meets With Investors Ahead of Debut Five-Part Euro Bond
summary: Uber Technologies Inc. has hired banks to hold calls with investors this week for a debut euro bond sale, the latest US tech firm to raise money in Europe.

title: Japan’s Preferred Networks Seeks IPO to Keep Up in AI Chip Race
summary: Japanese startup Preferred Networks Inc. is seeking to go public to mass-produce its chips, a reflection of the rising cost and scale needed to stay relevant in a global AI race.

title: AI-Discovered Drug Reverses Aging Markers in Study, Biotech Says
summary: An experimental lung disease drug developed using artificial intelligence showed promise in reversing biological signs of aging, pointing to broader potential use of the treatment, according to its developer.

title: IQE CEO Warns of Emerging China Supply Risk for Chip Industry
summary: IQE Plc Chief Executive Officer Jutta Meier said access to indium phosphide substrates is emerging as a key risk for the semiconductor industry as Chinese export controls create uncertainty over supplies.

title: Zeiss Overhauls SAP Cloud Migration After Costs Hit €200 Million
summary: Germany’s Zeiss Group, a key supplier to the global semiconductor industry, overhauled plans to move to a new cloud-based SAP SE software service after costs swelled to more than €200 million ($232 million) over several years.

title: Malaysia Eyes Huawei Chips for AI Project Despite US Warning
summary: Malaysia is leaning toward relying on Huawei Technologies Co.’s artificial intelligence chips to power its sovereign AI efforts, in what would be a major victory for Chinese AI technology in the face of strong opposition from President Donald Trump’s administration.

title: Horizons Middle East & Africa 9/7/2026
summary: Horizons Middle East & Africa is your daily spotlight on one of the world's fastest-growing regions. Live from Dubai, we bring you the latest global markets and analysis, plus news-making interviews, with a special focus on MEA. All that and more, as you head to the office in the Gulf, pause for lunch in Hong Kong, or start your day in London or Johannesburg.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Tech Firms Eye Australia for AI Centers, Local Operator Says
summary: US tech titans are interested in building data centers in Australia, drawn by its green grid and proximity to Asia, as they face a growing backlash at home, according to AirTrunk Operating Pty Ltd.

title: Amazon Cargo Plane Overshoots Runway, Closing Miami Airport
summary: An Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport and burst into flames on Sunday, shutting down the airport’s runways and taxiways and prompting an emergency response. This video has been updated to include additional footage. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Australia’s AI Boom Risks Demand Surge and Higher Rates, BE Says
summary: Australia’s data center boom risks pushing demand beyond the economy’s supply capacity, fueling inflation and requiring the Reserve Bank to run higher interest rates, according to James McIntyre at Bloomberg Economics.
